catalog.name: codewhale
catalog.description: First-party Codewhale extensions: the plugins and skills Codewhale ships, maintained in the open so anyone can propose a change.

plugins.name: chromewhale
plugins.description: Let Codewhale read and act on selected Chrome tabs and frames, one granted site at a time. Needs the bundled Chrome extension loaded.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: cloudflare
plugins.description: Cloudflare Workers workflows for Codewhale: build and test Workers, deploy with cf only after you approve, use KV, R2, D1 and Durable Objects, and move Pages projects to Workers.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: cloudflare-docs
plugins.description: Search current Cloudflare documentation through its official remote MCP. No account or credential required.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: codewhale-skills
plugins.description: 47 workflows for coding, research, documents, email, calendar, travel, shopping and local audio. Account and tool setup is separate; see the skill directory.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: Control apps with Codewhale. macOS beta; unsigned Windows preview and experimental Linux/Docker support.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: design-review
plugins.description: Review a user interface three ways: a severity-ranked design critique, a WCAG-based accessibility audit with a static scanner and contrast calculator, and a UX copy review.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: github-workflow
plugins.description: Review pull requests, triage issues and file well-formed issues through GitHub's official remote MCP server. Needs your own GitHub token; never posts without your approval.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: hello-extension
plugins.description: A runnable sample of a native TypeScript extension: one greeting tool and /hello-greet. Install it to see the review flow; it only runs with the experimental extension host turned on.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: linear-workflow
plugins.description: Triage Linear issues, claim work with evidence and post status updates through Linear's official remote MCP server. Needs your own Linear API key.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: loop
plugins.description: Run a task again and again until it is done: /loop <prompt> [--max N] [--until <phrase>] re-prompts the session after every reply, with a hard iteration cap, a completion phrase and /cancel-loop.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: review-toolkit
plugins.description: Six read-only specialist reviewers (silent failures, type design, test gaps, comment accuracy, simplification, general correctness) and a /review-pr command that fans them out over your diff and merges one ranked report.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: skills-dev-process
plugins.description: Software process workflows: plan, implement, debug, test, review, security-review, simplify, verify, hand off, and interview for missing requirements.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: skills-docs
plugins.description: Workflows for Word, PDF, PowerPoint and Excel files, plus writing repository documentation. No account or connection needed.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: skills-google
plugins.description: Workflows for Gmail and Google Calendar through a connected tool or your own OAuth client. Does not connect an account by itself.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: skills-personal
plugins.description: Everyday workflows for bank balances, shopping, flights, local Photos, Spotify, speech, podcasts and image search. Each skill states its own setup.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: vercel-workflow
plugins.description: Vercel workflows for Codewhale: preview and production deploys only after you approve, environment variables, runtime and build logs, and Next.js configuration.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: web-artifacts-builder
plugins.description: Build a self-contained single-file or small React and Tailwind page locally, check that it is really self-contained, and preview it on loopback.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: whalesong
plugins.description: Review agent traces and failures, compare runs, and turn session timing into audio. Requires the local Whalesong platform.
plugins.author: Codewhale

plugins.name: whalewiki
plugins.description: Understand a repo, find where to change it, and see which docs depend on a file. Source citations, freshness checks and a searchable offline reader.
plugins.author: Codewhale
